[Prospective students]{.eyebrow}

::: {.lead}
Curious about joining the lab? [Email me](mailto:dmdrown@alaska.edu?Subject=%5Blabwebsite%5D).
:::

Financial support for students accepted into the department and this research
group comes through a combination of research assistantships and teaching
assistantships. Interested students are also encouraged to apply for graduate
research fellowships, such as the
[National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship](https://www.nsfgrfp.org/).

Students with demonstrated lab abilities, wet or dry, and the capacity for data
analysis and writing are preferred and encouraged to apply. Contact me with a
letter of interest, a curriculum vitae including a summary of grades, and the
names of at least two references.

## About UAF and Fairbanks

The University of Alaska Fairbanks is renowned for its strengths in wildlife,
ecology, and evolutionary biology research. More information is available about
the [University](http://www.uaf.edu/), the
[Institute of Arctic Biology](http://www.iab.uaf.edu/), and the
[Department of Biology and Wildlife](http://www.bw.uaf.edu/).

Curious about life in Fairbanks? The department maintains a
[write-up on living here](http://www.bw.uaf.edu/graduates/life-in-fairbanks.php).
